5400.speaker: Field Officer
5400.text: Commander, the squall during the sea crossing has swept some of our ships off course.

5400.speaker: Field Officer
5400.text: Our small detachment will have to march eastward alone. The Emperor has ordered us to proceed with all possible haste to the Wizard's Palace.

5400.speaker: Field Officer
5400.text: Sir Anston and the remainder of your forces can rejoin with us there.

5400.speaker: Field Officer
5400.text: Commander, two small squads of fighters have been sighted in the surrounding forest...

5400.speaker: Field Officer
5400.text: How could they have learned of our arrival so quickly?

5401.speaker: Field Officer
5401.text: Our western division is under attack! How would you have us assemble, Sir Varius?

5401.speaker: Field Officer
5401.text: Sir! Should we fight through to their catapults, or flank their front line and crush them between our combined forces?

5402.speaker: Field Officer
5402.text: Our eastern division has been completely shattered! Duke Pellus leads his vanguard at our Emperor! We must reach him before he is overrun!

5402.speaker: Duke Pellus
5402.text: Capture the boy alive if possible! Cut down the rest!

5403.speaker: Field Officer
5403.text: Merovin infantry approach along the river, supported by cavalry traveling the ridgeline.

5403.speaker: Field Officer
5403.text: Baron Valeuve means to test our strength, Commander.

5404.speaker: Field Officer
5404.text: The guard at the bridge keep has been reinforced, but our reserves have arrived as well.

5404.speaker: Field Officer
5404.text: How should we form our ranks, Sir Varius?

5405.speaker: Field Officer
5405.text: Baron Valeuve approaches to treat with you before the battle, Commander.

5405.speaker: Enemy Commander
5405.text: Sir Varius, I will not support this child of an Emperor nor will I yield my lands over to his rule.

5405.speaker: Enemy Commander
5405.text: Retire from the field now, or you leave me no choice but to cut your army to pieces.

5405.speaker: Enemy Commander
5405.text: I shall await your retreat from my battle line. Do not take long in your decision.

5405.speaker: Field Officer
5405.text: What is your command, Sir Varius?

5405.speaker: Baron Valeuve
5405.text: Men of Valeuve, grant no quarter! Advance and destroy the enemy of Merovin!

5406.speaker: Enemy Commander
5406.text: Gather your men, sergeant! Hold them here for as long as possible!

5406.speaker: Field Officer
5406.text: East a half day's march sits Castle Corbeau, Commander.

5406.speaker: Field Officer
5406.text: Though it appears a peasant militia has been raised to resist our approach.

5407.speaker: Field Officer
5407.text: Commander, the enemy has dug a picket line and brought up musketeer and cannon support from the castle.

5407.speaker: Field Officer
5407.text: May the grace of the Emperor see us through this battle.

5407.speaker: Picket Line
5407.text: Militia advance! Keep them at cannon range!

5408.speaker: Field Officer
5408.text: The town of Corbeau is just south of the castle, Commander.

5408.speaker: Field Officer
5408.text: It would make a strong rally point if we capture it before laying siege to the castle.

5409.speaker: Field Officer
5409.text: Towns such as these cover the foothills of Bordavia and provide trade into the region.

5409.speaker: Field Officer
5409.text: This particular town is within the domain ruled by Count Valamir.

5410.speaker: Field Officer
5410.text: Count Valamir's vanguard approaches from the east, Sir Varius!

5410.speaker: Field Officer
5410.text: Our full force has yet to arrive. We need more time!

5411.speaker: Field Officer
5411.text: Count Valamir's army has arrived, Commander.

5411.speaker: Field Officer
5411.text: Wait... another battle group descends from the northern trail!

5411.speaker: Field Officer
5411.text: Bordavian mercenaries! Count Valamir hired a company of crossbowmen and delayed his attack until their arrival.

5411.speaker: Valamir Army
5411.text: Men of Carrone. Bordavia is open to you no longer. Surrender this town and return to your own country...

5411.speaker: Valamir Army
5411.text: or I will put each of your heads upon pikes as a warning to your kinsmen!

5412.speaker: Field Officer
5412.text: The main body of your army has yet to make their landing at Whitecliff, Commander.

5412.speaker: Field Officer
5412.text: His Grace, the Duke of Stokeshire, has put these men under your command as an honor guard to his castle.

5412.speaker: Field Officer
5412.text: Sir, our only chance of escape is across the river!

5412.speaker: Field Officer
5412.text: If we can't find a defendable front, they will overwhelm us!

5413.speaker: Field Officer
5413.text: We've gained the high ground! They will pay dearly if they mount an assault upon this position.

5413.speaker: Field Officer
5413.text: From this height we might even be able to see Castle Stokeshire...

5413.speaker: Field Officer
5413.text: Smoke rising in the west! Castle Stokeshire is under attack!

5413.speaker: Field Officer
5413.text: We must finish these brigands quickly if we are to reach the castle in time to aid them.

5414.speaker: Field Officer
5414.text: May devils take you, Martin! To think I once called you brother! Now I name you kinslayer!

5414.speaker: Enemy Commander
5414.text: Yield then! I have need of your lands, not your life.

5414.speaker: Field Officer
5414.text: And with these lands you would war against the Empire. Father would not have wished it, and so our lands came to me.

5414.speaker: Enemy Commander
5414.text: One of his greater follies, and his last.

5414.speaker: Field Officer
5414.text: Sir Varius! The castle is nearly done for!

5414.speaker: Field Officer
5414.text: If we are to save the Duke, we must rally his remaining men and strike at the attacker's siege engines!

5414.speaker: Martin Landower
5414.text: Keep at it, lads! The bailey is ours and the keep is ripe to fall!

5414.speaker: Martin Landower
5414.text: Where are those cursed trebuchets? That gate should be rubble by now!

5415.speaker: Field Officer
5415.text: Your army has been well provisioned by the Carrone camp and awaits your marching orders.

5415.speaker: Field Officer
5415.text: And the legion's general has arrived to discuss a battle strategy for conquering the pass.

5415.speaker: Field Officer
5415.text: You will no doubt recall Lord Anston, Viscount of Carrone and General of the Third Legion.

5415.speaker: War Advisor
5415.text: Sir Varius. I knew your worth would be recognized by the Emperor. It is good to see you again after so long.

5415.speaker: War Advisor
5415.text: If it were only under better circumstances. This campaign into Aguilleon will be hard fought and cost us many brave soldiers before it is done.

5415.speaker: War Advisor
5415.text: The legion will assist with war engines for the assault on the lower gate here, but their transport through the high pass will be most difficult.

5415.speaker: War Advisor
5415.text: It will fall upon your vanguard to clear the pass to El Acclazar if we are to support your siege of that great fortress.

5415.speaker: War Advisor
5415.text: I will make ready the legion and await your advance. May the Gods smile upon us, Sir Varius.

5415.speaker: War Advisor
5415.text: Conquer the gate as quickly as possible. The longer we fight here the more of their damned griffon riders will descend upon us.

5416.speaker: War Advisor
5416.text: The Third Legion's war engines will take time to gain the summit of the pass.

5416.speaker: War Advisor
5416.text: If we should come under attack now, they would be especially vulnerable.

5416.speaker: War Advisor
5416.text: It will be up to your vanguard to shield them from danger. If too many war engines are lost, you will not have the strength to conquer El Acclazar.

5416.speaker: War Advisor
5416.text: Encircle the war engines! Do not give them a clear line to strike!

5417.speaker: War Advisor
5417.text: The war engines of the Third Legion are in position and reserve infantry will march forward after your advance.

5417.speaker: War Advisor
5417.text: Press forward on the road quickly, or your reserves will not have the room to deploy.

5417.speaker: Field Officer
5417.text: Our vanguard awaits your assembly orders, Commander. The men stand unafraid and will follow you to the very end. We will conquer El Acclazar.

5417.speaker: War Advisor
5417.text: All of the reserves are now committed to the field. Lead us to victory, Sir Varius.

5418.speaker: Field Officer
5418.text: This village is too close to our coastal shipyards and would be a natural launching point for Hunewold raids.

5418.speaker: Field Officer
5418.text: For this reason, this location also becomes ideal for the site of your fortress, Sir Varius.

5418.speaker: Field Officer
5418.text: The village tribe has gathered to repel us, rather than retreating into the wood as is their usual war strategy. Something has inspired them, even if their chance of victory is hopeless.

5418.speaker: Field Officer
5418.text: Spirits of their ancestors rise up to fight alongside their shamans!

5418.speaker: Field Officer
5418.text: It is as if we battle against armies of present and past!

5419.speaker: Field Officer
5419.text: Hunewold tribesmen approach from all sides, Sir Varius.

5419.speaker: Field Officer
5419.text: I have inspected the perimeter and found the towers and ramparts secure, though the moat is still incomplete for our high ground defense.

5419.speaker: Field Officer
5419.text: We should be able to repel any assault this rabble can muster.

5419.speaker: Field Officer
5419.text: Sir Varius. It appears that three different tribes are part of this attack.

5419.speaker: Field Officer
5419.text: Their advance is disorganized and they have little knowledge of formation, but the fact that they are cooperating is cause for concern.

5420.speaker: Field Officer
5420.text: Sir Varius, I come with word just delivered from our far watch patrol.

5420.speaker: Field Officer
5420.text: A horde of Hunewold tribesmen, of a size greater than any met during the first conquest, has emerged from the east.

5420.speaker: Field Officer
5420.text: The tribes have united under a single war leader, Armagni, with the sole purpose of raiding and burning all imperial settlements in the Hunewold.

5420.speaker: Field Officer
5420.text: Their first hammer stroke will fall upon our fortress here. It will be up to us to turn the tide or be swept away under their onslaught.

5420.speaker: Field Officer
5420.text: By the gods! The very trees sway with the stamp of their approach!

5420.speaker: Field Officer
5420.text: My apologies, my lord. The men are ready and the fortress sound. Lead us through this terror to victory and the Hunewold is the Empire's once more.

5421.speaker: Field Officer
5421.text: You have the Emperor's trust and favor, Sir Varius.

5421.speaker: Field Officer
5421.text: The honor of leading the army that will first face the Horselords has been given to you.

5421.speaker: Field Officer
5421.text: As we march east and draw their fury upon us, Duke Stokeshire and Viscount Anston will land ships upon the Mirror Sea coast and retake our first settlement.

5421.speaker: Field Officer
5421.text: Attacking this small encampment will be the spark that ignites the Horselords' ire. We must keep them blind to our fleet if they are to land safely.

5422.speaker: Field Officer
5422.text: Two days since our attack upon their camp and still no counter from the Horselords.

5422.speaker: Field Officer
5422.text: Their attention must be fixed upon us for our landing at the Mirror Sea to be successful.

5422.speaker: Field Officer
5422.text: Sir Varius! Horselords riding hard from the west!

5422.speaker: Field Officer
5422.text: REGROUP! They seek to strike at the rear flanks of our column!

5423.speaker: Field Officer
5423.text: The Horselords have arrived in strength, Sir Varius. Our scouts estimate they have nearly twice our number.

5423.speaker: Field Officer
5423.text: With still no messenger from our allies, we must assume that the fleet has been lost.

5423.speaker: Field Officer
5423.text: Our few against their many, we shall give them such a battle that will not long be forgotten.

5423.speaker: Field Officer
5423.text: We fight for Sir Varius! We fight for the Emperor! WE FIGHT FOR CARRONE!

5423.speaker: War Advisor
5423.text: By the grace of the Emperor...!

5423.speaker: Field Officer
5423.text: And for the glory of Carrone!

5424.speaker: Field Officer
5424.text: Commander, the squall during the sea crossing has swept some of our ships off course.

5424.speaker: Field Officer
5424.text: Our small detachment will have to march eastward alone. The Emperor has ordered us to proceed with all possible haste to the Wizard's Palace.

5424.speaker: Field Officer
5424.text: Sir Anston and the remainder of your forces can rejoin with us there.

5425.speaker: Field Officer
5425.text: Commander, look to the east - the Wizard's Palace is being assaulted!

5425.speaker: Field Officer
5425.text: They are unaware of our approach - we may be able to surprise them and take out their rear flank.

5425.speaker: Field Officer
5425.text: We'll need to fight our way through the warp portals on top of those dunes...

5425.speaker: Field Officer
5425.text: The portals will warp us to the Palace interior. We should be safe inside the Wizard's Palace.

5425.speaker: Field Officer
5425.text: Commander, enemy reinforcements have arrived! We're severely overmatched - we must escape through the warp portals or we will surely perish!

5426.speaker: Dark Sorcerer
5426.text: Sir Varius you've arrived just in time! The Palace is under attack!

5426.speaker: Dark Sorcerer
5426.text: As friends to the Empire, we beseech you - help us man those Ballistae and defend our palace!

5426.speaker: Field Officer
5426.text: Commander, that warp portal will give us access to the battlefield below if you so choose.

5427.speaker: Field Officer
5427.text: Commander, these hilltop villages are under attack!

5427.speaker: Field Officer
5427.text: These must be the bandits the Wizards warned us about.

5427.speaker: Field Officer
5427.text: It's a good thing the lost ships carrying reinforcements were able to rejoin with us after the battle at the Wizard's Palace.

5427.speaker: War Advisor
5427.text: Yes, it is an honor to take the field of battle at your side once again Sir Varius.

5427.speaker: War Advisor
5427.text: Let's show these lawless bandits the wrath of the Empire!

5427.speaker: War Advisor
5427.text: That nearby warp portal should give us access to the southern hilltop.

5427.speaker: Field Officer
5427.text: Look there, bandits are attacking the villagers across the canyon!

5428.speaker: War Advisor
5428.text: It is as I feared Varius. Caladrin has already sustained some damage from the assault.

5428.speaker: War Advisor
5428.text: Varius these villagers we rescued have agreed to join our cause. Among them are some talented Craftsmen.

5428.speaker: Desert Chieftain
5428.text: It is my honor to serve the Emperor. Caladrin is home to many families, including my own - we should not delay!

5428.speaker: War Advisor
5428.text: These Craftsmen could be invaluable in assisting the repair efforts.

5428.speaker: War Advisor
5428.text: We must escort them safely inside the city.

5428.speaker: Field Officer
5428.text: Yeah, but how do we get there?

5428.speaker: Bandits
5428.text: This desert is our domain. You are not welcome here.

5428.speaker: Field Officer
5428.text: Commander, those Dune Sirens are using their magic to create Quicksand!

5428.speaker: War Advisor
5428.text: I do not see an alternate route, we'll have to pass through it.

5429.speaker: Enemy Commander
5429.text: Curses! I thought I had seen the last of you when I evaded capture in Sangsoleil.

5429.speaker: War Advisor
5429.text: Martin Landower?? What in blazes are you doing out here?

5429.speaker: Enemy Commander
5429.text: Just running an errand for someone. If you are as wise as I remember, you'll stay out of my way.

5429.speaker: War Advisor
5429.text: Do not be blinded by your own greed Landower!

5429.speaker: War Advisor
5429.text: Break off this assault and the Emperor may go lightly on you.

5429.speaker: Enemy Commander
5429.text: Haha! Greed no longer motivates me... only power!

5429.speaker: Enemy Commander
5429.text: If you want to help these people tell them to open the city gates!

5429.speaker: Landower's Forces
5429.text: Varius, I see you're determined to defend this city...

5429.speaker: Landower's Forces
5429.text: No matter, you've not seen the full power of the forces I command!

5429.speaker: Landower's Forces
5429.text: These Conjurers will have me inside Caladrin by nightfall whether you like it or not.

5429.speaker: Landower's Forces
5429.text: Bring down the walls men! Caladrin falls today! Bring the item to me when it is done.

5429.speaker: Landower's Forces
5429.text: Commander, Landower is fleeing the battle!

5429.speaker: Landower's Forces
5429.text: More of Landower's Forces have been sighted to the south...

5429.speaker: Landower's Forces
5429.text: ...and to the northeast! Another of those blasted Conjurers is with them!

5430.speaker: War Advisor
5430.text: From the top of this large dune we should be able to see most of the surrounding lands.

5430.speaker: Field Officer
5430.text: Ugh, these endless patrols in the desert have turned up no signs of Landower so far.

5430.speaker: Field Officer
5430.text: Marching through this sandy wasteland is not my idea of a pleasant afternoon.

5430.speaker: War Advisor
5430.text: If you had done as much scouting as you have complaining we might have found Landower by now.

5430.speaker: Field Officer
5430.text: Commander, what manner of creature is that? They look hungry.

5430.speaker: War Advisor
5430.text: Some type of giant desert leeches, I believe the locals call them 'Blood Gorgers'.

5430.speaker: War Advisor
5430.text: Commander, Landower has somehow tamed these Blood Gorgers so they will fight for him.

5430.speaker: War Advisor
5430.text: Let's cut down these foul beasts!

5430.speaker: Field Officer
5430.text: Commander, our Dune Sirens should be able to slow down their advance.

5430.speaker: Field Officer
5430.text: Perhaps we should deploy them down the hillside and get some Quicksand in front of those leeches.

5430.speaker: Field Officer
5430.text: Those Blood Gorgers are getting stronger as they feed.

5430.speaker: Landower's Forces
5430.text: Commander we should hurry to the top of the dune and secure a strong defensive position.

5431.speaker: Field Officer
5431.text: Boy is it ever warm out here!

5431.speaker: War Advisor
5431.text: Varius, there looks to be a lone Conjurer on top of that ridge.

5431.speaker: Field Officer
5431.text: What is he doing out here all alone?

5431.speaker: War Advisor
5431.text: Perhaps we can capture him and get some information on Landower?

5431.speaker: Field Officer
5431.text: Oh no! They've got us flanked!

5432.speaker: War Advisor
5432.text: Sir Varius, Landower's hideout stands before us.

5432.speaker: War Advisor
5432.text: Once we penetrate their defenses we should locate and capture Landower.

5432.speaker: Enemy Commander
5432.text: Welcome to my humble oasis. I must say, I'm flattered that you bothered to travel all this way.

5432.speaker: Enemy Commander
5432.text: You must be tired after such a journey. Why don't you join with me and you won't have to die in this wasteland?

5432.speaker: War Advisor
5432.text: In the name of His Imperial Majesty, surrender now Landower!

5432.speaker: War Advisor
5432.text: Give up, and I can promise you safe passage back to Carrone. The Emperor wants a word with you.

5432.speaker: Enemy Commander
5432.text: Ha ha ha! Very amusing Sir Anston, but I don't think I'll be surrendering just yet...

5600.speaker: War Advisor
5600.text: Greetings, Sir Varius. It is good to see you safe and well through the Merovin Rebellion.

5600.speaker: War Advisor
5600.text: While you wage war to recover the lost kingdoms of the Empire, I have been given the honor of rebuilding the Third Carrone Legion.

5600.speaker: War Advisor
5600.text: Your assistance in training the recruits is greatly appreciated. Grant me but a moment to address the men before we begin.

5600.speaker: War Advisor
5600.text: Men of Carrone! Today you will learn to fight as soldiers of the Third Legion!

5600.speaker: War Advisor
5600.text: The path to victory lies in gaining advantage over your enemy. Each army's strength has its counter strategy!

5600.speaker: War Advisor
5600.text: A large force of foot troops will be powerful, but they are slow to maneuver and vulnerable to ranged attack! Cavalry will be quick and devastating in the charge, but will break upon a reinforced pikewall!

5600.speaker: War Advisor
5600.text: In facing a reinforced position, such as this fortress, war engines are critical in bringing down the walls or gate!

5600.speaker: War Advisor
5600.text: The defender will likely be in position to strike first, so a tight formation of armored soldiers will be needed to shield your advancing army!

5600.speaker: War Advisor
5600.text: Sir Varius, I will take command of the defending force. Rest assured my crossbowmen will give your army a warm welcome.

5618.speaker: Field Officer
5618.text: Form ranks for defense! Flee east if you can!

5623.speaker: Rukiev Settlement
5623.text: A Horselord column has ridden in from the east!

5623.speaker: Rukiev Settlement
5623.text: A second column now, to the west!

5624.speaker: Field Officer
5624.text: Varius, a band of Mysterious Foes are just beyond the treeline.

5624.speaker: Field Officer
5624.text: The Ballistae from the Wizard's Palace should come in handy for cutting them down as they advance!

5625.speaker: Field Officer
5625.text: More Mysterious Foes are attempting to block access to the warp portals Commander.

5625.speaker: Field Officer
5625.text: Commander, large enemy platoons have been sighted in the east...

5625.speaker: Field Officer
5625.text: ...and the west. I sense a bloody battle ahead.

5627.speaker: Field Officer
5627.text: This narrow canyon is the perfect opportunity for an ambush Varius.

5627.speaker: Field Officer
5627.text: Let's deploy on the top of these ridges and thin out their numbers.

5627.speaker: Bandits
5627.text: Commander, bandits are approaching from the west!

5627.speaker: Bandits
5627.text: Another group of bandits, it must be a caravan!

5627.speaker: Bandits
5627.text: Focus fire Varius! Don't let them escape!

5627.speaker: Bandits
5627.text: This is the last gang of bandits in the caravan.

5627.speaker: Bandits
5627.text: Let's finish them off and call it a day.

5628.speaker: War Advisor
5628.text: Varius, this desert settlement is under attack!

5628.speaker: War Advisor
5628.text: Landower's forces have already penetrated their defenses.

5628.speaker: Field Officer
5628.text: Commander, a sizable assault platoon has just been spotted south of the ruined gate!

5630.speaker: Field Officer
5630.text: Commander, the area is infested with Blood Gorgers!

5630.speaker: Field Officer
5630.text: Oh no, now Landower's men are joining the fray!

5630.speaker: Field Officer
5630.text: The sounds of the battle must have attracted them.

5631.speaker: Field Officer
5631.text: Finally, a place to relax and refill my canteen...

5631.speaker: War Advisor
5631.text: Don't get too relaxed. It seems Landower's Forces want to pick a fight.

5631.speaker: War Advisor
5631.text: A formation of cavalry has appeared in the northeast Varius!

5631.speaker: Field Officer
5631.text: Commander, another Conjurer group has been sighted!

5800.speaker: Field Officer
5800.text: Commander, the squall during the sea crossing has swept some of our ships off course.

5800.speaker: Field Officer
5800.text: Our small detachment will have to march eastward alone. The Emperor has ordered us to proceed with all possible haste to the Wizard's Palace.

5800.speaker: Field Officer
5800.text: Sir Anston and the remainder of your forces can rejoin with us there.

5800.speaker: Field Officer
5800.text: Commander, two small squads of fighters have been sighted in the surrounding forest...

5800.speaker: Field Officer
5800.text: How could they have learned of our arrival so quickly?

5801.speaker: War Advisor
5801.text: We shall reach the imperial city by tomorrow, squire. Tonight we will treat the men to meat and wine in the village ahead.

5801.speaker: War Advisor
5801.text: What is this now? Looters fleeing the coming war?

5801.speaker: War Advisor
5801.text: Cut down these brigands! Show them the price of cowardice!

5802.speaker: War Advisor
5802.text: Wake up, squire. The day is upon us and the men need to be assembled.

5802.speaker: War Advisor
5802.text: A levy of militia has formed from the local folk. They wish to march with us to fight for Carrone. I have agreed to their request.

5802.speaker: War Advisor
5802.text: Deploy the men in formation in the field outside the village. We march to our Emperor's call.

5802.speaker: War Advisor
5802.text: The men are ready then? Good.

5802.speaker: War Advisor
5802.text: We march west along the road to the imperial city.

5803.speaker: War Advisor
5803.text: Our Emperor is young, but cautious.

5803.speaker: War Advisor
5803.text: He leaves no path to Carrone unguarded against Duke Pellus, even this small vale west of his main force.

5803.speaker: War Advisor
5803.text: We may not see much in the way of battle today squire, but stay close and I will teach you the way of war.

5803.speaker: War Advisor
5803.text: We have crossbowmen and catapults well placed on the ridge. We should let the enemy come to us while we rain rock and arrow down upon their heads.

5803.speaker: War Advisor
5803.text: As their army closes with ours, try to position the cavalry in line for a charge. With our foot soldiers... ATTACK AT WILL!

5803.speaker: War Advisor
5803.text: Flank and surround the enemy units to deliver more damage with each melee attack! Break holes in their line to weaken their formation defense!

5803.speaker: War Advisor
5803.text: Sweep around their position! Close in and finish them!

5804.speaker: Field Officer
5804.text: This is our last chance to train before we head to the Wizard's Palace so let's make the most of it!

5804.speaker: Field Officer
5804.text: Now advance and engage the enemy!

5804.speaker: Field Officer
5804.text: First you'll need to order your troops to advance. Tap on a unit in your army to select it. Yellow highlights indicate where the selected unit can move.

5805.speaker: Field Officer
5805.text: Now let's practice our siege tactics on this old castle.

5805.speaker: Field Officer
5805.text: First, you'll need to deploy three of your war engines on top of that ridge.

5805.speaker: Field Officer
5805.text: Tap on a war engine and it will appear in the yellow highlighted area on the ridge. Tap on a war engine within the highlighted area to fix its position.

5805.speaker: Field Officer
5805.text: Repeat this until all three war engines have been deployed. Then tap the 'Fight' button to start the battle.

5805.speaker: Field Officer
5805.text: Target the same section of wall with each shot to create a breach. Fire at will!
